responsibility: Implements the gm2 process scheduler on top of COROUTINES. It owns process descriptors, ready/waiting/passive/dead queues, urgency-based process selection, creation of coroutine-backed processes and an idle listener process, state transitions for Activate/Suspend/Switch/Wait/Stop operations, event-source mapping through coroutine interrupt attachments, and the module-specific exception source, thereby providing the full cooperative process runtime consumed by Preemptive and concurrent Modula-2 code.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the Processes pair: instead of merely declaring the ISO process API like Processes.def, it defines the ProcessId record layout, ready/waiting/passive/dead queues, urgency-based selection, coroutine switching, event attachment mapping, and runtime exception support.
